title: *Nash Nest*-Hot tub, Air hockey & Bar!
description:
Spacious 3 bedroom home in a quiet neighborhood only minutes away from the airport, lake, Grand Ole Opry and 10 minutes to Downtown! Our house can accommodate larger groups or families with kids. The rec room has a bar and an air hockey table. Right outside the rec room doors is a patio and a hot tub for some relaxation. There are tons of restaurants and cafes close by, along with Walgreens and other convenience stores. Military & first responders discount.

Guest access
Whole home is available to our guests.
